prompt: what are top 10 most sold products overall and which products have lowest sales. compare across multiple metrics such as units sold and sales velocity
title: Top and Low Sales Products
summary: Analyze the top 10 best-selling products overall and identify the lowest-selling products. Compare them across multiple metrics, including units sold and sales velocity.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ps.product_id,
        ps.total_units_sold,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_units_sold DESC, ps.product_id) AS desc_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_units_sold ASC, ps.product_id) AS asc_rank
    FROM product_sales ps
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN r.desc_rank <= 10 THEN 'top_10_most_sold'
        ELSE 'lowest_selling'
    END AS segment,
    r.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    p.category_id,
    p.type_id,
    r.total_units_sold,
    r.desc_rank,
    r.asc_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN retail.products p
    ON p.product_id = r.product_id
WHERE r.desc_rank <= 10
   OR r.asc_rank <= 10
ORDER BY segment, total_units_sold DESC, product_id;

WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS number_of_orders_containing_product,
        AVG(oi.quantity::numeric) AS average_units_per_order,
        SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
        AVG((oi.unit_price - COALESCE(oi.discount_amount, 0))::numeric) AS average_selling_price_after_discount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)) AS active_selling_months,
        SUM(oi.quantity)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)), 0) AS sales_velocity
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN retail.orders o
      ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        pm.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.total_units_sold DESC, pm.product_id) AS top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pm.total_units_sold ASC, pm.product_id) AS low_rank
    FROM product_metrics pm
), selected AS (
    SELECT product_id, 'top_10_most_sold_products' AS selection_group
    FROM ranked
    WHERE top_rank <= 10
    UNION
    SELECT product_id, 'lowest_selling_products' AS selection_group
    FROM ranked
    WHERE low_rank <= 10
)
SELECT
    s.selection_group,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    p.category_id AS category,
    p.type_id AS type,
    r.total_units_sold,
    r.sales_velocity,
    r.number_of_orders_containing_product,
    r.average_units_per_order,
    r.total_revenue,
    r.average_selling_price_after_discount
FROM selected s
JOIN ranked r
  ON r.product_id = s.product_id
JOIN retail.products p
  ON p.product_id = s.product_id
ORDER BY s.selection_group, r.total_units_sold DESC, p.product_id;
